verses.original: קְֽרָא־ נָ֭א הֲיֵ֣שׁ עוֹנֶ֑ךָּ וְאֶל־ מִ֖י מִקְּדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּפְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qə·rā- nā hă·yêš ‘ō·w·ne·kā wə·’el- mî miq·qə·ḏō·šîm tip̄·neh
verses.literal: Call out if you please but who will answer To which of the holy ones will you turn
verses.literalPt: Chama, agora; há alguém que te responda? A qual dos entes santos te dirigirás?

verses.original: כִּֽי־ לֶֽ֭אֱוִיל יַהֲרָג־ כָּ֑עַשׂ וּ֝פֹתֶ֗ה תָּמִ֥ית קִנְאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- le·’ĕ·wîl ya·hă·rāḡ- kā·‘aś ū·p̄ō·ṯeh tā·mîṯ qin·’āh
verses.literal: For resentment kills a fool and envy slays the simple
verses.literalPt: Pois a insubmissão mata o fátuo, e o apaixonamento tira a vida ao parvo.

verses.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ רָ֭אִיתִי אֱוִ֣יל מַשְׁרִ֑ישׁ וָאֶקּ֖וֹב נָוֵ֣הוּ פִתְאֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ănî- rā·’î·ṯî ’ĕ·wîl maš·rîš wā·’eq·qō·wḇ nā·wê·hū p̄iṯ·’ōm
verses.literal: I have seen a fool taking root but suddenly his house was cursed
verses.literalPt: Eu vi o fátuo criando raízes; mas, de repente, declarei maldita a sua habitação.

verses.original: יִרְחֲק֣וּ בָנָ֣יו מִיֶּ֑שַׁע וְיִֽדַּכְּא֥וּ בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: yir·ḥă·qū ḇā·nāw mî·ye·ša‘ wə·yid·dak·kə·’ū ḇaš·ša·‘ar wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: His sons are far from safety crushed in court without a defender
verses.literalPt: Seus filhos estão longe da segurança, são espezinhados na porta, e não há quem os livre.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר קְצִיר֨וֹ׀ רָ֘עֵ֤ב יֹאכֵ֗ל וְאֶֽל־ מִצִּנִּ֥ים יִקָּחֵ֑הוּ וְשָׁאַ֖ף צַמִּ֣ים חֵילָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer qə·ṣî·rōw rā·‘êḇ yō·ḵêl wə·’el- miṣ·ṣin·nîm yiq·qā·ḥê·hū wə·šā·’ap̄ ṣam·mîm ḥê·lām
verses.literal: The hungry consume . . . his harvest taking it even from the thorns and the thirsty pant after his wealth
verses.literalPt: A sua messe é devorada pelo faminto, que a arrebata até dentre os espinhos, e o laço abre as fauces para a fazenda deles.

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ לֹא־ יֵצֵ֣א מֵעָפָ֣ר אָ֑וֶן וּ֝מֵאֲדָמָ֗ה לֹא־ יִצְמַ֥ח עָמָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō- yê·ṣê mê·‘ā·p̄ār ’ā·wen ū·mê·’ă·ḏā·māh lō- yiṣ·maḥ ‘ā·māl
verses.literal: For distress does not spring from the dust and trouble does not sprout from the ground
verses.literalPt: Pois a iniquidade não procede do pó, nem da terra brota a aflição;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֭דָם לְעָמָ֣ל יוּלָּ֑ד וּבְנֵי־ רֶ֝֗שֶׁף יַגְבִּ֥יהוּ עֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·ḏām lə·‘ā·māl yūl·lāḏ ū·ḇə·nê- re·šep̄ yaḡ·bî·hū ‘ūp̄
verses.literal: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks . . . fly upward
verses.literalPt: Mas o homem nasce para a aflição, tão certamente como as faíscas voam para cima.

verses.original: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶל־ אֵ֑ל וְאֶל־ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אָשִׂ֥ים דִּבְרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lām ’ă·nî ’eḏ·rōš ’el- ’êl wə·’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ā·śîm diḇ·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: However if I were you I would appeal to God and lay my cause before Him
verses.literalPt: Porém, quanto a mim, eu buscaria a Deus e a Deus entregaria a minha causa.

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת וְאֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת עַד־ אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śeh ḡə·ḏō·lō·wṯ wə·’ên ḥê·qer nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ ‘aḏ- ’ên mis·pār
verses.literal: the One who does great and unsearchable things wonders . . . without number
verses.literalPt: O qual faz coisas grandes e inescrutáveis, maravilhas sem número.

verses.original: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן מָ֭טָר עַל־ פְּנֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ וְשֹׁ֥לֵֽחַ מַ֝יִם עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: han·nō·ṯên mā·ṭār ‘al- pə·nê- ’ā·reṣ wə·šō·lê·aḥ ma·yim ‘al- pə·nê ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: He gives rain to . . . the earth and sends water upon . . . the fields
verses.literalPt: Ele faz chover sobre a terra e envia águas sobre os campos,

verses.original: לָשׂ֣וּם שְׁפָלִ֣ים לְמָר֑וֹם וְ֝קֹדְרִ֗ים שָׂ֣גְבוּ יֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: lā·śūm šə·p̄ā·lîm lə·mā·rō·wm wə·qō·ḏə·rîm śā·ḡə·ḇū ye·ša‘
verses.literal: He sets the lowly on high so that mourners are lifted to safety
verses.literalPt: de modo que põe os abatidos num lugar alto; e os que choram são exaltados à segurança.

verses.original: מֵ֭פֵר מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת עֲרוּמִ֑ים וְֽלֹא־ תַעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה יְ֝דֵיהֶ֗ם תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·p̄êr maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ ‘ă·rū·mîm wə·lō- ṯa·‘ă·śe·nāh yə·ḏê·hem tū·šî·yāh
verses.literal: He thwarts the schemes of the crafty so that their hands find no success
verses.literalPt: Ele frustra as maquinações dos astutos, de maneira que as suas mãos não possam acabar o seu empreendimento.

verses.original: לֹכֵ֣ד חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעָרְמָ֑ם וַעֲצַ֖ת נִפְתָּלִ֣ים נִמְהָֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: lō·ḵêḏ ḥă·ḵā·mîm bə·‘ā·rə·mām wa·‘ă·ṣaṯ nip̄·tā·lîm nim·hā·rāh
verses.literal: He catches the wise in their craftiness and sweeps away the plans of the cunning
verses.literalPt: Ele apanha os sábios na sua astúcia, e o conselho dos perversos é precipitado.

verses.original: יוֹמָ֥ם יְפַגְּשׁוּ־ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וְ֝כַלַּ֗יְלָה יְֽמַשְׁשׁ֥וּ בַֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·mām yə·p̄ag·gə·šū- ḥō·šeḵ wə·ḵal·lay·lāh yə·maš·šū ḇaṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim
verses.literal: They encounter darkness by day and grope at noon as in the night
verses.literalPt: De dia, se acham em trevas e, ao meio-dia, andam às apalpadelas, como de noite.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣שַׁע מֵ֭חֶרֶב מִפִּיהֶ֑ם וּמִיַּ֖ד חָזָ֣ק אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ša‘ mê·ḥe·reḇ mip·pî·hem ū·mî·yaḏ ḥā·zāq ’eḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth and from the clutches of the powerful
verses.literalPt: Porém Deus salva da espada que sai da boca deles; ele salva o necessitado da mão do poderoso.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֣י לַדַּ֣ל תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝עֹלָ֗תָה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî lad·dal tiq·wāh wə·‘ō·lā·ṯāh qā·p̄ə·ṣāh pî·hā
verses.literal: So the poor have hope and injustice shuts its mouth
verses.literalPt: Assim há esperança para o pobre, e a iniquidade tapa a boca.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אַשְׁרֵ֣י אֱ֭נוֹשׁ יוֹכִחֶ֣נּֽוּ אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּמוּסַ֥ר שַׁ֝דַּ֗י אַל־ תִּמְאָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’aš·rê ’ĕ·nō·wōš yō·w·ḵi·ḥen·nū ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ū·mū·sar šad·dai ’al- tim·’ās
verses.literal: Blessed indeed is the man whom God corrects so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty
verses.literalPt: Eis que feliz é o homem a quem Deus reprova. Portanto, não desprezes a correção do Todo-Poderoso.

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַכְאִ֣יב וְיֶחְבָּ֑שׁ יִ֝מְחַ֗ץ וְיָדוֹ תִּרְפֶּֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî hū yaḵ·’îḇ wə·yeḥ·bāš yim·ḥaṣ wə·yå̄·ḏō tir·pe·nāh
verses.literal: For He wounds but He also binds He strikes but His hands also heal
verses.literalPt: Pois ele faz a ferida e a ata. Ele fere, e as suas mãos curam.

verses.original: בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ צָ֭רוֹת יַצִּילֶ֑ךָּ וּבְשֶׁ֓בַע׀ לֹא־ יִגַּ֖ע בְּךָ֣ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šêš ṣā·rō·wṯ yaṣ·ṣî·le·kā ū·ḇə·še·ḇa‘ lō- yig·ga‘ bə·ḵā rā‘
verses.literal: He will rescue you from six calamities no harm will touch you in seven
verses.literalPt: Em seis tribulações, ele te livrará, e, em sete, o mal não te tocará.

verses.original: בְּ֭רָעָב פָּֽדְךָ֣ מִמָּ֑וֶת וּ֝בְמִלְחָמָ֗ה מִ֣ידֵי חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rā·‘āḇ pā·ḏə·ḵā mim·mā·weṯ ū·ḇə·mil·ḥā·māh mî·ḏê ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: In famine He will redeem you from death and in battle from the stroke of the sword
verses.literalPt: Na fome, ele te redimirá da morte e, na guerra, do poder da espada.

verses.original: בְּשׁ֣וֹט לָ֭שׁוֹן תֵּחָבֵ֑א וְֽלֹא־ תִירָ֥א מִ֝שֹּׁ֗ד כִּ֣י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šō·wṭ lā·šō·wn tê·ḥā·ḇê wə·lō- ṯî·rā miš·šōḏ kî yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue and will not fear havoc when it comes
verses.literalPt: Estarás escondido do açoite da língua e não terás medo da assolação, quando chegar.

verses.original: לְשֹׁ֣ד וּלְכָפָ֣ן תִּשְׂחָ֑ק וּֽמֵחַיַּ֥ת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אַל־ תִּירָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šōḏ ū·lə·ḵā·p̄ān tiś·ḥāq ū·mê·ḥay·yaṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ’al- tî·rā
verses.literal: You will laugh at destruction and famine and need not fear the beasts of the earth
verses.literalPt: Da assolação e da penúria, te rirás e não terás medo das feras da terra.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עִם־ אַבְנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֣ה בְרִיתֶ֑ךָ וְחַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה הָשְׁלְמָה־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘im- ’aḇ·nê haś·śā·ḏeh ḇə·rî·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh hā·šə·lə·māh- lāḵ
verses.literal: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field and the wild animals will be at peace with you
verses.literalPt: Pois terás aliança com as pedras do campo, e as feras do campo estarão em paz contigo.

verses.original: וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־ שָׁל֣וֹם אָהֳלֶ֑ךָ וּֽפָקַדְתָּ֥ נָ֝וְךָ וְלֹ֣א תֶחֱטָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- šā·lō·wm ’ā·ho·le·ḵā ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tā nā·wə·ḵā wə·lō ṯe·ḥĕ·ṭā
verses.literal: You will know that your tent is secure and find nothing amiss when inspecting your home
verses.literalPt: Saberás que a tua tenda está em paz, visitarás o teu rebanho, e nada te faltará.

verses.original: וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־ רַ֣ב זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֶ֗יךָ כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- raḇ zar·‘e·ḵā wə·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’e·ḵā kə·‘ê·śeḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: You will know that your offspring will be many your descendants like the grass of the earth
verses.literalPt: Também saberás que se multiplicará a tua descendência, e a tua posteridade, como a erva da terra.

verses.original: תָּב֣וֹא בְכֶ֣לַח אֱלֵי־ קָ֑בֶר כַּעֲל֖וֹת גָּדִ֣ישׁ בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: tā·ḇō·w ḇə·ḵe·laḥ ’ĕ·lê- qā·ḇer ka·‘ă·lō·wṯ gā·ḏîš bə·‘it·tōw
verses.literal: You will come to the grave in full vigor like a sheaf of grain gathered in season
verses.literalPt: Em boa velhice, entrarás na sepultura, como se recolhe a meda de trigo a seu tempo.

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ זֹ֭את חֲקַרְנ֥וּהָ כֶּֽן־ הִ֑יא שְׁ֝מָעֶ֗נָּה וְאַתָּ֥ה דַֽע־ לָֽךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- zōṯ ḥă·qar·nū·hā ken- hî šə·mā·ʿen·nāh wə·’at·tāh ḏa‘- lāḵ
verses.literal: Indeed we have investigated . . . and it is true So hear it and know for yourself
verses.literalPt: Eis que isso nós o temos provado, assim o é; ouve-o e conhece-o tu para o teu bem.
